summary: SR Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a data security incident at its internal audit service provider, Mercadien, P.C. CPAs. An unauthorized actor accessed files containing certain customer data (name, SSN, account numbers). No specific deal terms, stake, price, premium, or dates are provided. The board has not issued a recommendation or retained advisors. The incident is deemed not material to financial condition. What to watch: potential regulatory inquiries or customer litigation; no risk-arb angle as this is a cybersecurity disclosure, not a special situation.
